title: Feature Catalog by Origin
html:
Find an implemented product function, its data source, SQL and filters. Open a linked detail for the behavior and limits. This inventory describes the repository's composition, not which connections or permissions are active in a particular installation. Conditional availability is stated below; future work belongs in the implementation plan.

VR Master — Pilar da Terra

Function What it does / available criteria SQL and details Availability
Sales consultation Value and quantity; inclusive dates, literal product phrase, monthly/product grouping, previous year or equal-day period comparison Sales options, complete SQL and access predicates Configured Runtime reader and VRM-VEN-01
Product lookup Find products by the reviewed classification, cost center, buyer, description and flags; include/exclude, descendants and combined criteria Every catalog filter, status, relationships and example SQL Configured Runtime reader and VRM-PRD-01; only enabled catalog dimensions
Sales of a product selection Constrain sales to a verified current registration selection, including products beyond the visible preview; reuse a completed lookup from this ERP Product membership and permissions Both sales and product permissions

VR Master is the sales/product data source. PDT Connect is a sign-in integration; signing in through PDT Connect does not select an ERP or grant its sales permission by itself.

Inspect a sales discrepancy

  1. Open the source's sales page. Check its definition of a sale and the fixed rules visible in the SQL: the two ERPs do not measure the same relation.
  2. Choose the measure and grouping to open the complete SQL. Copy or download it in the portal, then bind the documented example parameters in your database client. Examples contain synthetic dates/phrases, no ERP records or credentials.
  3. Match the actual date interval, literal or semantic product selection and effective permission restrictions. A restriction by sale-time buyer differs from filtering the current product registration buyer. Quantity partitions must retain their unit/packaging.
  4. For comparisons, use the separate comparison bindings. previous_period is an equal-day interval, not necessarily the preceding calendar month. Both periods use the same current product membership.

Documentation reading never queries an ERP. Downloaded SQL runs only when you explicitly execute it through your own authorized database client. The examples document the production compiler; they are not captured SQL from a particular person's request or proof of live ERP reconciliation.

Maintenance

The composition owns which runtime modules and capabilities exist. This index routes to their canonical domain documentation. When adding/removing a product function, update its row here in the same change; do not maintain a second normative description in this index. The OpenAPI reference contains the exhaustive HTTP operation inventory, including administrative and operational endpoints.

SQL variants, supported measures/groupings, filter dimensions, exposure status and access predicates are generated from the production compilers/catalogs by feature-reference.ts. Run pnpm -C apps/api references:write, then pnpm docs:references:write. The corresponding check commands reject drift. No environment file, model call or ERP connection is needed to generate these feature references; the broader API reference command also verifies the migrated local application schema as usual.
